About the Company

For a fast-growing technology company, part of an expanding entrepreneurial group, we are looking for an experienced IT Projects&Digital Transformation Manager to lead the development and implementation of integrated technology solutions, supporting business growth, operational efficiency and digital transformation.

The Opportunity

This is a newly created position, offering the opportunity to shape the company's IT strategy, drive technology initiatives and build a scalable IT environment, with the potential to build and develop an internal team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and implement the IT strategy, aligning technology initiatives with business objectives and growth plans.
  • Lead complex IT and software projects, from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation and integration.
  • Coordinate the selection, implementation and integration of ERP, CRM and other business applications, ensuring a connected and efficient IT ecosystem.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, digitalization and automation across business functions.
  • Evaluate and implement AI-powered solutions, promoting their adoption through internal training and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Oversee IT infrastructure, networks, hardware, software and cybersecurity, ensuring a secure, reliable, and scalable environment.
  • Manage and optimize internal IT platforms, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Intranet and collaboration tools.
  • Translate business needs into technical requirements and coordinate external IT providers and technology partners.
  • Collaborate closely with senior management to identify technology priorities and support strategic decision-making.
  • Develop IT processes and standards and progressively build an internal IT team as the company grows.
Candidate Profile
  • Solid experience in IT management, software project management or digital transformation, including large-scale technology implementation projects.
  • Proven experience in implementing and integrating ERP, CRM and other business-critical applications.
  • Strong technical understanding of IT infrastructure, networks, hardware, software, cybersecurity and Microsoft technologies.
  • Good knowledge of business process automation, system integration and practical AI applications.
  • Experience in managing external technology providers and coordinating cross-functional projects.
  • Experience gained in both multinational companies and entrepreneurial environments would be a strong advantage.
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, combined with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Proactive, dynamic and adaptable, with the ability to take ownership and drive initiatives independently.
  • Professional maturity, strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to build structures, implement change and operate in a fast-paced environment.
